02 / MEET THE MAKER

The person
behind the play.

I’m Lê Anh Khoa, a game developer based in Đà Nẵng. I like making movement feel responsive, systems feel intuitive, and small details feel satisfying.

I build Roblox experiences at Rivrs Games, using Claude as part of my AI-assisted development workflow. Previously, I worked on Sipher Odyssey at Ather Labs.
